subject: Request: temporary purchase process for GearShift pilot
messages:
From: Amira Khan <amira.khan@gearshift.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jake Morales <jake.morales@gearshift.io>, purchasing@gearshift.io
Date: 2026-04-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary purchase process for GearShift pilot

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Were looking to spin up a 6-week pilot with Redwood (single team, internal dev environment). Given the short timeline and the fact this is an early pilot, our procurement team is asking whether Redwood can accept invoices without a standing PO for this engagement while we finalize contract terms on our side.

High-level details:
- Expected spend: ~$12k total over 6 weeks (single invoice or monthly)
- Work: access to Redwood Dedicated for a short pilot; Redwood hosted API seat for our dev team
- Legal: were not requesting changes to Redwoods standard terms for the pilot period, just a temporary invoice process to avoid procurement delays

Can you outline what Redwood would need from us to consider a temporary no-PO path (evidence, forms, limits)? If possible, wed like a short checklist so our finance team can prepare. Ive CCd Jake (finance) and purchasing. I can send a W-9 and a contact for billing when you confirm next steps.

Appreciate it — were excited to get started.

— Amira
Amira Khan
Head of Partnerships, GearShift
amira.khan@gearshift.io
+1 415-555-0192
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Amira Khan <amira.khan@gearshift.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary purchase process for GearShift pilot

Amira —

Thanks for the clear summary. We can often accommodate short pilots without a standing PO but we require a small set of controls to protect both sides. To move quickly, please provide the items below and well route an internal exception for temporary invoice-only handling (30-60 day window, renewable):

Required from GearShift:
- Completed temporary PO exception form (attached) — includes invoice routing contact and billing entity
- W-9 or local tax form (PDF)
- Target invoice cadence (single invoice vs monthly) and max invoice amount per month
- Primary technical contact for the pilot and the SOW/notes describing services

Internal notes / what well do:
- Cap single-invoice amount to $10k by default; exceptions need a manager sign-off (Marcus is on this thread)
- Require monthly reconciliation and expedited payment terms for pilot invoices
- Log the waiver in our procurement playbook and set an audit window (90 days)

Im attaching the temporary exception form. Once you return that + the W-9 well aim to approve the exception within 2 business days. Marcus can confirm any additional limits from Procurement side.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Ops Manager, Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Phone: 650-555-0114
Attachment: Redwood_temp_PO_exception_form.docx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Amira Khan <amira.khan@gearshift.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-20T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary purchase process for GearShift pilot

Looping in procurement specifics — quick notes from our side on safeguards wed apply if we grant a temporary no-PO lane:

1) Invoice cap and cadence: Default monthly cap $10k; if customer expects >$10k in a single invoice we need manager approval and a brief business justification.
2) Evidence: W-9 + point-of-contact + short SOW (one paragraph) are sufficient for pilots. No long-form contracts required for a single 30–60 day exception.
3) Payment terms: Net 30 preferred; if GearShift needs different terms please flag that now.
4) Auditability: Well require you to accept emailed invoices to billing@redwood.ai and retain copies in your accounting system for 120 days to support any follow-up.
5) Escalation & renewals: If the pilot converts to a multi-month engagement well transition to a PO-backed workflow and handle procurement handoff early in negotiations.

Im attaching the current draft of our internal waiver playbook so Rachel and Vanessa can confirm operational steps. Feedback welcome from GearShift on invoice timing.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Attachment: temp_waiver_playbook_v0.2.pdf
From: Amira Khan <amira.khan@gearshift.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jake Morales <jake.morales@gearshift.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-23T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary purchase process for GearShift pilot

Rachel / Marcus —

Thanks for the quick responses and for the form. Attached: GearShift_W-9.pdf and a one-page pilot statement of work (SOW) with invoice cadence noted as a single invoice upon completion (target ~$12k). Jake confirms Net 30 is fine. 

We agree to the $10k default cap — for this pilot well split into two month-end invoices (Decoupled to keep each under $10k), so that should align with your threshold. Well also send invoices to billing@redwood.ai and keep records per your audit ask.

Next steps:
- We uploaded the completed exception form to the shared Drive link you provided (drive link in case you need it).
- Please confirm when the temporary invoice-only path is approved so we can schedule provisioning.

Appreciate your help — excited to get going.

Best,
Amira Khan
Head of Partnerships, GearShift
Attachments: GearShift_W-9.pdf, GearShift_Pilot_SOW.pdf
